an7.53:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahāmoggallāno Dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ cārikaṃ caranti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
an7.53:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Veḷukaṇṭakī Nandamātā upāsikā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsati.
an7.53:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Vessavaṇo mahārājā uttarāya disāya dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati kenacid-eva karaṇiyena.
an7.53:2.2: Assosi kho Vessavaṇo mahārājā Nandamātāya upāsikāya pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsantiyā, sutvā kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno aṭṭhāsi.
an7.53:3.1: Atha kho Nandamātā upāsikā pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsitvā tuṇhī ahosi.
an7.53:3.2: Atha kho Vessavaṇo mahārājā Nandamātāya upāsikāya kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā abbhānumodi
an7.53:3.5: ‘Ahan te bhagini bhātā Vessavaṇo mahārājā' ti.
an7.53:3.6: ‘Sādhu bhadramukha, tena hīyo me ayaṃ dhammapariyāyo bhaṇito, idan te hotu ātitheyyan' ti.
an7.53:3.7: ‘Sādhu bhagini, etañ c' eva me hotu ātitheyyaṃ:
an7.53:3.8: sve ca Sāriputta-Moggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso Veḷukaṇṭakaṃ āgamissati, tañ ca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisitvā mamaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ ādiseyyāsi,
an7.53:3.9: etañ ca me bhavissati ātitheyyan' ti. 2.
an7.53:4.1: Atha kho Nandamātā upāsikā tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpesi.
an7.53:4.2: Atha kho Sāriputta-Moggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso yena Veḷukaṇṭako tad avasari.
an7.53:4.3: Atha kho Nandamātā upāsikā aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi
an7.53:4.4: ‘ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhusaṅghassa kālaṃ ārocehi:
an7.53:4.5: kālo bhante, ayyāya Nandamātuyā nivesane niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan' ti.
an7.53:4.6: ‘Evaṃ ayye' ti kho so puriso Nandamātāya upāsikāya paṭissutvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhusaṅghassa kālaṃ ārocesi:
an7.53:4.7: kālo bhante, ayyāya Nandamātuyā nivesane niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
an7.53:4.8: Atha kho Sāriputta-Moggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Nandamātāya upāsikāya nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an7.53:4.9: Atha kho Nandamātā upāsikā Sāriputta-Moggallānapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
an7.53:5.1: Atha kho Nandamātā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an7.53:5.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ āyasmā Sāriputto etad avoca
an7.53:5.3: ‘ko pana te Nandamāte bhikkhusaṅghassa abbhāgamanaṃ ārocesī' ti?
an7.53:6.1: ‘Idhāhaṃ bhante rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsitvā tuṇhī ahosiṃ.
an7.53:6.2: Atha kho bhante Vessavaṇo mahārājā mama kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā abbhānumodi
an7.53:6.5: "Ahan te bhagini bhātā Vessavaṇo mahārājā" ti.
an7.53:6.6: "Sādhu bhadramukha, tena hīyo me ayaṃ dhammapariyāyo bhaṇito, idan te hotu ātitheyyan" ti.
an7.53:6.7: "Sādhu bhagini, etañ c' eva me hotu ātitheyyaṃ,
an7.53:6.8: sve ca Sāriputta-Moggallānappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso Veḷukaṇṭakaṃ āgamissati, tañ ca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisitvā mamaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ ādiseyyāsi,
an7.53:6.9: etañ ca me bhavissati ātitheyyan" ti.
an7.53:6.10: ‘Yad idaṃ bhante dāne puññaṃ hitaṃ Vessavaṇassa mahārājassa sukhāya hotū' ti. 3.
an7.53:7.2: yatra hi nāma Vessavaṇena mahārājena evaṃmahiddhikena evaṃmahesakkhena devaputtena sammukhā sallapissasī' ti.
an7.53:8.1: ‘Na kho me bhante es' eva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo,
an7.53:8.2: atthi me añño pi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:8.3: idha me bhante Nando nāma ekaputtako piyo manāpo,
an7.53:8.4: taṃ rājāno kismiñci-d-eva kāraṇe okkassa pasayha jīvitā voropesuṃ,
an7.53:8.5: tasmiṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante dārake gahite vā gayhamāne vā vadhe vā vajjhamāne vā hate vā haññamāne vā nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattan' ti. 4.
an7.53:8.7: yatra hi nāma cittuppādaṃ pi parisodhessasī' ti.
an7.53:9.1: ‘Na kho me bhante es' eva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo,
an7.53:9.2: atthi me añño pi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:9.3: idha me bhante sāmiko kālakato aññataraṃ yakkhayoniṃ upapanno,
an7.53:9.4: so me ten' eva purimena attabhāvena uddassesi.
an7.53:9.5: Na kho panāhaṃ bhante abhijānāmi tato nidānaṃ cittassa aññathattan' ti. 5.
an7.53:9.7: yatra hi nāma cittuppādaṃ pi parisodhessasī' ti.
an7.53:10.1: ‘Na kho me bhante es' eva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo,
an7.53:10.2: atthi me añño pi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:10.3: yato' haṃ bhante sāmikassa daharass' eva daharā ānītā, nābhijānāmi sāmikaṃ manasā pi aticarittā, kuto pana kāyenā' ti? 6.
an7.53:10.5: yatra hi nāma cittuppādamattam pi parisodhessasī' ti.
an7.53:11.1: ‘Na kho me bhante es' eva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo,
an7.53:11.2: atthi me añño pi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:11.3: yadāhaṃ bhante upāsikā paṭidesitā, nābhijānāmi kiñci sikkhāpadaṃ sañcicca vītikkamitā' ti. 7.
an7.53:12.1: ‘Na kho me bhante es' eva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo,
an7.53:12.2: atthi me añño pi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:12.3: idhāhaṃ bhante yāva-d-eva ākaṅkhāmi, vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi;
an7.53:12.4: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi;
an7.53:12.5: pītiyā ca virāgā upekhakā ca viharāmi, satā ca sampajānā sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi, yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekhako satimā sukhavihārī' ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi;
an7.53:12.6: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmī' ti. 8.
an7.53:13.1: ‘Na kho me bhante es' eva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo,
an7.53:13.2: atthi me añño pi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo:
an7.53:13.3: yānīmāni bhante Bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni, nāhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmī' ti.
an7.53:14.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto Nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmī ti. Mahāyaññavaggo pañcamo. Tass' uddānaṃ:
